instruction_summary: Re-estimate Shimer (2012)'s job-finding-share (C1/C2 two-state) and gross-flows (C3 three-state) decompositions on CPS data through mid-2026 and visualize how the findings evolved over time.

steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install numpy scipy pandas statsmodels matplotlib requests

steps.description: Fetched 13 FRED series (3 stocks + duration check + 9 gross-flows) via keyless fredgraph.csv, NaN-preserving
Part 1 two-state: eq(4)/(5) with 1.1 redesign factor from 1994-01, 2020-03 clip, within-window HP(1e5) detrend, Newey-West(8) SEs; all windows + 20yr rolling + C2 descriptives
Part 2 three-state: BLS flows -> monthly 3x3 transition matrices -> eigenvalue time-aggregation correction -> eq(7) decomposition across windows
Assembled combined estimates, series_monthly.csv, flagship two-panel figure and window-comparison figure

comparison_to_original.note: Both match paper 0.77; anchor gate passed.
1.1-factor spec reproduces paper 0.90 more tightly than replication's published-tail splice.
New: claim holds through 2026 except across the 2020 COVID layoff shock.

deviations: Used the spec-mandated x1.1 CPS-redesign factor on UEMPLT5 from 1994-01 (Appendix-A fn 38) instead of the seeded replication's microdata-share + published-tail splice; maintained as an assumption post-2010. Reproduces the anchors more tightly.
Within-window HP(1e5) detrending and Newey-West(8) SEs per spec, vs the replication's detrend-once-then-subset + plain OLS (coincide for the full-sample anchor).
Three-state update starts 1990-02 (BLS published flows) and cannot extend the paper's 1967 start; tests recent-decades conclusion only. Flows not margin-error adjusted.
2020-03 F clipped to 0.01 (only out-of-range month); 2025 shutdown gap (stocks miss 2025-10, flows miss 2025-10/11) dropped, never interpolated; 2025Q3/Q4 and 2026Q3 excluded from samples.
C4 demographic heterogeneity not updated (needs matched CPS microdata; out of scope).
